# MLAI marketing and docs — isolated review implementation

Approved input: the supplied architectural brief followed by the user's Sites / Build Web Apps / Build Web Page instruction. Build now; do not replace existing production surfaces.

## Correction and boundaries
The connected GitHub reads show an existing `MLAI-CORPORATION-WWW` integration repository and active `apps/web` Next.js application. This is an isolated review/migration candidate, not a greenfield replacement. No repository, user computer, account, domain or deployment will be changed.

## Design
True-white editorial engineering identity, graphite text, muted secondary copy, thin rules, violet product accents, contrasting dark technical section. System fonts only. Hero: “Intelligence, with integrity.” No invented metrics, badges, testimonials, availability or pricing. Native semantic project relationship diagram; its label explicitly says conceptual. This is a code-native design; no approved image concept exists and no image-to-render fidelity claim will be made.

## Surfaces
Homepage; four-project directory and detail routes; eight documentation pages including overview; evidence ledger; about; local-only project brief composer; 404. Responsive navigation, search dialog, theme toggle, project filters, conceptual diagram selection, copy feedback, brief validation/download, keyboard behavior, reduced motion.

## Source and runtime
One typed content source feeds TSX components, local search and generated MDX. Next.js App Router candidate uses React and headless Fumadocs MDX/Core; shared CSS is imported after Tailwind 4. Search and lightweight controls use progressive enhancement. Native controls deliberately avoid unneeded Motion, shadcn and font dependencies.

The environment cannot resolve npm hosts. Therefore ship a runnable dependency-free review export generated from the same pure TSX components using a review-only serializer. It is not a React renderer or a Next build and does not validate React hydration, Fumadocs or server bundling. Browser-test the export. Ship Next source but explicitly leave install, dependency resolution, lockfile, full framework typecheck/build and deployment as outstanding gates.
